1.
Heard learned Advocate for the Applicant, learned Advocate Mr.Halwasia for the Passport Authority of India and learned Advocate for Respondent No.2-original Complainant.
2 . T h e o r d e r o f i s s u a n c e o f p r o c e s s i s s t a y e d b y t h i s C o u r t a s p e r t h e 902-IA(ST)-3675-2025-IN-WP-3867-2018.doc order dated 11th January 2024.
It was a private case for the offences under Sections 406 and 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ("IPC").
The Applicant wants "No Objection Certificate" for renewal of the passport.
3. A Division Bench of this Court by an order dated 27 th January 2025 has already directed the Passport Authority to issue fresh passport for a period of 5 years.
In that case, the Applicant was convicted for one offence under IPC.
According to Mr.Halwasia, there are also other cases.
Learned Advocate assures that he will move the concerned Court for necessary direction.
4. As per the provisions of Passports Act, 1967 and the Notification issued by the Central Government, this Court can certainly issue necessary directions.
It can be for 5 years and he is required to obtain permission prior to leaving India.

Furthermore, if other cases are there, he is required to take necessary direction from the concerned Court, if it is already not obtained.
5. In view of that, the Application is disposed of.

[ S. M. MODAK, J.]
